name: pam_shield
detailed_description: Automatically blocks IP addresses attempting brute-force password guessing attacks. Monitors failed login attempts and applies dynamic firewall rules to prevent further attacks from the same source.
notes:
Similar to pam_faillock but uses firewall rules for blocking. Requires iptables access.
